title: Spectacular Speeder Chase
front_description: The astonishing speeder chase through Coruscant continues. Zam Wesell's quick detour into a tram tunnel prompts an emergency move by Anakin. Before Obi-Wan can say anything, the young Jedi excuses himself, leaps out of his vehicle and plunges hundreds of stories. "I hate it when he does that," Obi-Wan mumbles to himself. Anakin makes a perfect landing on Zam's speeder, which he begins to incapacitate with his lightsaber.
back_description: Doug Chang's concept drawing of Anakin's speeder, appropriated during the Zam Wesell pursuit
